title: java-diff-utils renders explicit and implicit equal rows
summary: Explicit equal lines changed from CHANGE to EQUAL. The customized prefix and suffix were each decorated once in both representations.

change.description: A renderer receiving explicit equal deltas should identify unchanged lines and apply the same equality formatting used for unchanged text between edits.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
